question: Why is the unlimited limiter not within the domain of time according to the scriptures?
premises: The unlimited limiter is not conceptually constructible as a limited object.
Therefore it is not within the domain of time.
The knowable-property status belongs to time, not to that limiter.
inference: Time governs knowable, delimited properties, so the unlimited limiter cannot fall under time's domain.
plain_english: Therefore it is not constructible and, as the scriptures say, not within the domain of time; for that reason the condition of being a knowable object is explained as belonging to time.
